{{Top|title=''Haven''-class medical station}} {{Otheruses|Haven}} {{Update|{{HelmetCollectionCite|23|Databank A-Z}}}} {{StarshipClass |image=[[File:HavenClassMedicalStation-MF73.png]] |name=''Haven''-class medical station |designer= |manufacturer=[[VenteX Construction Yards]]{{BuildFalconCite|89|Starship Fact File}} |line= |model=Modified [[Haven-class space station|''Haven''-class space station]] |type=[[Space station]][[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' film]] |cost= |modifier= |sysmods= |length= |width=651.84 [[meter]]s |height= |mass= |max accel= |mglt= |max speed= |maneuverability= |engine= |hyperdrive= |hdrange= |hdsystem= |poweroutput= |power=[[Reactor|Main reactor]] |shield gen=Heavy [[deflector shield]]ing{{EncyclopediaCite|Republic and Separatist Ships (1)}} |hull=Powerful [[armor]] |sensor= |target= |navigation= |avionics= |maincomp= |countermeasures= |armament=Unarmed |complement=*Medical supplies{{Rebels|Always Two There Are}} *[[Pelta-class frigate|''Pelta''-class frigates]] *[[Venator-class Star Destroyer|''Venator''-class Star Destroyers]] |bays=8 [[Hangar|docking ports]] |escapepods= |crew=*1 [[Kaminoan]] [[technician]] *150 [[clone medical officer]]s *1,000+ [[medical droid]]s |skeleton= |passengers=80,000 {{C|maximum}} |capacity= |cargohandling= |consumables= |lifesupport= |communications=Equipped |othersystems=60,000 [[bacta tank]]s |availability= |role=*Space station *[[Medcenter]] |firstuse= |retired= |affiliation=[[Galactic Republic]] }} The '''''Haven''-class medical station''', also known as the '''Republic medical station''' or the '''Republic medical base''', was a model of [[space station]] manufactured by [[VenteX Construction Yards]] used by the [[Galactic Republic]] as a [[Realspace|space]]-bound [[medcenter]] during the [[Clone Wars]]. The [[Kaliida Shoals Medical Center]], located in the [[Ryndellia system]], was a ''Haven''-class medical station, as were the [[Ord Cestus medical station]] and [[Felucia Medical Station HCTFF2]]. The stations were designed so that from above, they looked like the [[Republic crest]]. ==Characteristics== [[File:HavenClassMedicalStationTop-MF89.png|thumb|270px|left|Viewed from above, Haven-class medical station resembled the Republic crest.]] ''Haven''-class medical stations{{Facebook|username=starwarsrebels|url=starwarsrebels/photos/a.230754950414469.1073741828.180356405454324/514414028715225|name=Star Wars Rebels|date=01-11-2015|quote=This station was anything but a safe haven for the Rebels.|archivefile=File:Haven-class-Canon-November-2-2015.png}} were medical [[space station]]s manufactured by [[VenteX Construction Yards]] built around a long central shaft, which comprised the longest axis of the station. The cylindrical central hub had eight equidistant protrusions, which included docking areas for [[starship]]s{{TCW|Shadow of Malevolence|Shadow of ''Malevolence''}} such as [[Venator-class Star Destroyer|''Venator''-class Star Destroyers]] and [[Pelta-class frigate|''Pelta''-class frigates]]. From above, the station's shape resembled the [[Republic crest]]. The stations could carry a maximum of 80,000 patients at any one time. ==Role== The stations were intended as [[medcenter]]s for the treatment of wounded [[Galactic Republic]] military personnel during the [[Clone Wars]], particularly [[clone trooper]]s. The ''Haven''-class had little defenses, and as such were targets for [[Confederacy of Independent Systems|Separatist]] attacks, so their locations were occasionally kept secret. In addition to serving as hospitals, ''Haven''-class facilities also served as way stations for resupplying the ships and bases of the Grand Army of the Republic.{{TCW|Brain Invaders}} ==History== ===Clone Wars===
[[File:Kaliida_Shoals_system.png|thumb|right|250px|The ''Malevolence'' attempts to destroy the Kaliida Shoals Medical Center.]]
The stations came into use during the [[The galaxy|galaxy-spanning]] Clone Wars. During the [[Battle of Christophsis]], after the destruction of their heavy-weapons depot,{{TCW|The Hidden Enemy}} [[Jedi General]]s [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker]] sent [[Admiral]] [[Wullf Yularen]] and their [[fleet]] to resupply from a medical station. However, in the midst of doing so, Yularen was contacted by [[Jedi Master]]s [[Mace Windu]] and [[Yoda]], who wanted him to immediately escort [[Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano]], who had been newly assigned to Skywalker without his knowledge, to [[Christophsis]] so she could bring him and Kenobi an urgent message from the [[Jedi High Council]]. Yularen begrudgingly agreed to do so, although he pointed out that he would be transporting empty ships. During the [[Malevolence Campaign|''Malevolence'' campaign]], [[General]] [[Grievous]] was sent in the warship ''[[Malevolence]]'' after the secret [[Kaliida Shoals Medical Center]] by [[Count]] [[Dooku]]. Skywalker and Tano led [[Shadow Squadron]] to [[Battle of the Kaliida Nebula|defend]] the station, with the [[BTL-B Y-wing starfighter/bomber|Y-wing bombers]] managing to take out the ''Malevolence''{{'s}} giant [[ion cannon]] before it could fire upon the station. [[File:TB73-SWM_Anthony_Devine.png|thumb|left|250px|''TB-73'' departs Ord Cestus medical station for Dantooine.]] The [[planet]] [[Felucia]] was a constant battleground between the Republic and Confederacy throughout the Clone Wars, and at one point, the Republic placed [[Felucia Medical Station HCTFF2]] in orbit. However, it was eventually [[Destruction of the Felucia medical station|destroyed]] by the Separatists, with a squadron of [[Vulture-class starfighter|vulture droids]] left to patrol the area. When Skywalker, Kenobi, and Tano arrived in a [[T-6 shuttle]] to investigate the station's loss of contact, they were subsequently forced down by the droids, becoming briefly stranded on Felucia.{{TCW|Bounty Hunters (episode)}} After the [[Second Battle of Geonosis]], Tano and fellow Padawan [[Barriss Offee]] were sent on the medical frigate ''[[TB-73]]'' to retrieve supplies from the [[Ord Cestus medical station|medical station]] near [[Ord Cestus]] to be delivered to Republic forces on [[Dantooine]]. However, an [[Skirmish aboard TB-73|infestation]] of Geonosian [[brain worm]]s complicated the journey, and by the time the frigate dropped out of [[hyperspace]], it was going too fast due to the [[death]]s of the [[pilot]]s. Two [[spacetug]]s managed to slow the ship down before it could collide with the medical station, and [[Jedi]] Master [[Kit Fisto]] boarded the ship with troops to help the infected. Tano and Offee recovered from their ordeal onboard the station, along with the [[trooper]]s of [[Tango Company]]. ===Imperial Era=== [[File:HavenMedicalStation-ATTA.png|thumb|right|250px|An abandoned ''Haven''-class medical station during the Imperial Era.]] ''Haven''-class stations fell out of use during the reign of the [[Galactic Empire]], but could still be found throughout the galaxy. In [[4 BBY]]''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of "[[Always Two There Are]]" to [[4 BBY]]. during the [[Early rebellion against the Galactic Empire|early rebellion]], several members of the [[Spectres]] [[Skirmish aboard a Republic medical station|visited]] an [[Unidentified Haven-class medical station|abandoned medical station]] on the advice of the former [[Clone Captain]] [[Rex]] to salvage medical supplies for [[Phoenix Cell]]. However, the [[Inquisitorius|Inquisitor]] [[Seventh Sister]] had left [[probe droid]]s at the station, as well as some other places, to watch for rebel and Jedi activity, and the rebels, who included Padawan [[Ezra Bridger]], got into a skirmish with the Seventh Sister and fellow Inquisitor [[Fifth Brother]] before managing to escape with a crate of medical supplies. ==Behind the scenes== A ''Haven''-class medical station first appeared in the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|''Clone Wars'' movie]]. The class was first [[canon]]ically identified as such in a ''[[Star Wars Rebels]]'' promotional Facebook post regarding the episode "[[Always Two There Are]]." {{Gallery |source=''Star Wars: The
